{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) welcomes the recent European-wide popular rejection of austerity politics.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA salutes the victory of François Hollande in the French presidential election.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande ran on a platform that rejected austerity policies of massive budget cuts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Austerity policies of massive budget cuts prolong both the Great Recession and the pain it visits upon working people and the poor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande’s program calls for a financial transactions tax.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande’s program calls for higher marginal tax rates on the rich to increase investment in education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande’s program calls for the hiring of 60,000 new teachers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande’s platform calls for a major raise in the minimum wage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"François Hollande’s platform calls for lowering, from age 62 to 60, the age at which manual laborers can retire and receive full public pensions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To achieve such policies, the broad left must win a majority in the June French parliamentary elections and stand firm on its pre-election pledges.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The fight against the global capitalist politics of austerity must be truly international.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States left must pressure the Obama administration to work with Hollande to restart the European economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States left must pressure the Obama administration to propose similar programs in the United States that would highlight the complete failure of austerity policies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
